title: Design System: Paper Development Workshop on Data Studies

tile-figure.purpose: The deadline date in the tile only; tile-only exception to the 96px display ceiling.

figure.purpose: Large light tabular figures in the dates list.

figure-id.purpose: The submission ID on the receipt.

headline.purpose: Section heads under the 1px rule; 400 below 720px.

statement.purpose: The about statement that fills word by word from grey to ink.

ticker.purpose: The scroll-linked dark green running band.

countdown.purpose: Countdown figures in the tile; 28px below 720px.

hero-statement.purpose: Hero statement, max 40ch; second sentence in IWI grey.

title.purpose: Sub-heads, hero date line, tile weekday, menu sheet links (300).

title-sm.purpose: Agenda titles and date descriptions; 20px below 720px.

lead.purpose: Introductory paragraphs (max 60ch) and the tile label; 18px below 720px.

control.purpose: Buttons, arrow links, section facts, faculty affiliation and role.

body.purpose: Running text and nav links; prose max 68ch.

body-sm.purpose: Field labels (600), checkboxes, bios, agenda details, mobile step of 18px text.

small.purpose: Hints, field errors (600), draft and utility bars, tables, footer base line.

caption.purpose: Countdown unit letters; mobile step of the draft bar and slot names. Floor is 13px.

label.purpose: Uppercase keys, footer column headings, status chips. Never above a heading.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Ease-out-expo for every movement.

motion.name: ease-soft
motion.purpose: Ease-out-cubic for colour and opacity in scroll effects.

motion.name: hero-rise
motion.purpose: Hero title rises out of a mask on load.

motion.name: hero-follow
motion.purpose: Date line, statement and links follow the title.

motion.name: tile-cut
motion.purpose: The IWI cut draws into the visible deadline tile once on load.

motion.name: field-entrance
motion.value: fade 600ms; flight 0.9s to 1.25s expo, staggered over 0.55s; settle 1s; loop parks
motion.purpose: Hero data field assembles into the tile's diagonal, then stops (WCAG 2.2.2).

motion.name: field-pointer
motion.value: repel radius 120px, push 46px, 8 links within 170px at max 0.25 alpha, spring-back
motion.purpose: Fine pointer only; the loop parks again at rest.

motion.name: countdown-roll
motion.purpose: Changed countdown digit rolls up; no seconds.

motion.name: statement-fill
motion.value: color 0.25s ease-soft, mapped 85% to 45% of the viewport
motion.purpose: Statement words fill grey to ink with scroll.

motion.name: shead-reveal
motion.purpose: One-shot section head reveal.

motion.name: dates-stagger
motion.purpose: One-shot dates list reveal.

motion.name: cut-scroll
motion.value: --cut-p 0 to 1 from field top at 100% to 55% of viewport, 70ms smoothing
motion.purpose: IWI cut on faculty and submit fields draws with scroll via a scaled paper triangle.

motion.name: agenda-progress
motion.value: 2px green line + 10px square, reading line 60%, 90ms smoothing
motion.purpose: Programme progress; passed times turn ink.

motion.name: ticker-scroll
motion.purpose: Ticker band moves only with scroll.

motion.name: magnetic
motion.value: reach 24px, max 8px, follow 0.07s, return 0.1s; press scale 0.97
motion.purpose: Header CTA and tile button follow a fine pointer.

motion.name: pointer-light
motion.value: radial 280px white, alpha 0.05 on HSG green / 0.07 on dark green, fade 0.5s
motion.purpose: Only gradient in the system; pointer-only, capped for contrast; none on the closed tile.

motion.name: row-sweep
motion.value: 2px line scaleX 0.45s var(--ease); first cell translate 6px
motion.purpose: Hover on index, dates, agenda and faculty rows.

motion.name: sheet-vt
motion.value: view transition: in 0.45s, out 0.28s var(--ease), IWI-diagonal edge
motion.purpose: Menu sheet wipe; fallback clip-path 0.45s from the top.

motion.name: arrow-nudge
motion.purpose: Button and arrow-link icons slide right on hover and focus.

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Button fill and colour changes.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Max width: 16px gutter, 60px bar, 40px tile cut, 56px sections, single-column rows.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Max width: 24px gutter, 88px sections, hero and splits stack.

breakpoints.name: nav
breakpoints.purpose: Max width: section links move into the disclosure menu.

breakpoints.name: xs
breakpoints.purpose: Max width: header call to action hides.

geometry.name: cut
geometry.purpose: Rise of the IWI diagonal on the deadline tile, about 6.5 degrees.

geometry.name: cut-wide
geometry.purpose: The same angle across the full-width faculty and submit fields; also the moving edge of the menu wipe.

motionPolicy.name: settle-and-stop
motionPolicy.purpose: Self-started motion stops within about 4s of load and never restarts on its own (WCAG 2.2.2).

motionPolicy.name: reduced-motion
motionPolicy.purpose: End states only: settled field drawn once, cuts drawn, words ink, ticker static, countdown text without roll, sweeps fade.

motionPolicy.name: forced-colors
motionPolicy.purpose: Data field, programme line, row sweeps and pointer light removed.

motionPolicy.name: print
motionPolicy.purpose: Field, ticker and countdown hidden; cuts removed; animations skipped.

motionPolicy.name: performance
motionPolicy.purpose: Transform, opacity and colour only; one rAF loop per module, idle when still; paused off-screen and in hidden tabs; 720-point cap, DPR 2.

narrative.overview:
The site reads like a call for papers from the host institute (IWI-HSG), set with the discipline of anduril.com and palantir.com: one humanist face, hierarchy by scale instead of decoration, hairline index rows instead of cards, and colour only as large flat fields. The ground is white; the one loud object is the HSG-green deadline tile with the IWI diagonal edge. Everything else is ink, grey and rules.

Density is calm and editorial: a 12-column grid, generous section padding, light-weight display type at large sizes, and figures (dates, times, IDs) set in tabular lining numerals. Depth comes only from flat colour fields (white, light grey band, dark green, HSG green), never from shadows or blur. Corners are square throughout.

Motion is a layer on top of a page that is complete without it. It only draws rules and diagonals, moves type, fills colour and assembles square data points; it never introduces a new material. Self-started motion is confined to the first seconds after load and then stops; everything after that answers the visitor's scroll or pointer.

The earlier "Sovereignty Radar" look (dark ground, glows, glass cards, pill buttons) is retired and is not a reference.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, ink text, HSG green reserved for actions, the deadline and key figures.
Full-bleed flat colour fields as section changes: light grey band, the dark green ticker band, dark green faculty and footer, HSG green submit band; faculty and submit open with the IWI cut.
One face (Source Sans 3) in three weights: 300 display, 400 text, 600 labels.
Hairline rows (1px) for lists, dates, programme, faculty and tables; no cards.
Square corners, no shadows, no blur; flat at rest.
A focal hero sequence that settles and stops, then motion driven only by scroll and pointer.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Colour appears as large flat fields or as the colour of an action. Never as a tint, glow, gradient or accent border at rest. The only exception is the pointer light (see Motion System), which exists only under a fine pointer and is capped so text contrast never drops.

rules.name: The Green Means Go Rule
rules.body: HSG green marks what the visitor can do or must not miss (actions, the deadline, progress through the programme). Decorative green is dark green, in full-bleed fields.

rules.name: The Hairline-Is-Not-Text Rule
rules.body: Rule grey is for hairlines and data points only; text, hints and control borders that must be seen use IWI grey or ink.

rules.name: The Scale Not Effects Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from size and the 300/400/600 weight steps. No gradient text, no outlines, no shadows on type. Motion may reveal or fill type; it never decorates it.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every date, time, count and ID uses lining tabular numerals, including the countdown.

rules.name: The Closed Ramp Rule
rules.body: New text uses a step from the ramp above; a size that is not listed is a defect, not a new step.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and in every state. State is shown by fill, colour, underline or a drawn line, never by lift or shadow.

rules.name: The Settle-and-Stop Rule
rules.body: Anything that moves without the visitor asking stops by itself within about 4s of load and never restarts on its own (WCAG 2.2.2). Ongoing motion is allowed only when it is the direct result of scroll or pointer input; the countdown changes at most once a minute.

rules.name: The Content-First Rule
rules.body: Effects are progressive enhancement. Nothing visible at load is hidden or moved by script; elements are armed only while off-screen; the page is complete without any fx file.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce every effect shows its end state: the hero field is drawn once as the settled ribbon, cuts and rules are drawn, statement words are ink, the ticker stands still, the countdown changes its text without rolling, row sweeps fade in at full length. Under forced colours the data field, programme line, row sweeps and pointer light are removed. In print, the field, ticker and countdown are hidden, cuts are removed and every animation is skipped.

dos: Do keep the ground white and let HSG green appear only as actions, the deadline tile, the submit band, the receipt, the key date and the programme progress line.
Do separate sections with full-bleed flat fields (white, band grey, dark green, HSG green) and open each with the 1px ink section-head rule.
Do list content as 1px hairline index rows with a key column, not as cards.
Do set display and figures in Source Sans 3 300 and every date, time, count and ID in tabular lining numerals.
Do take every text size from the ramp (13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26px and the listed fluid roles).
Do keep every corner square and every control at least 44px high (48px for primary controls).
Do use mint for secondary text on dark green and white for all text on HSG green.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette: green selection, green caret, green focus outline (white on green fields), grey-on-band scrollbar.
Do draw icons as stroked SVG (1.75 stroke, square caps, miter joins, 24px grid, rendered 16px to 22px).
Do let self-started motion settle and stop within about 4s, tie all later motion to scroll or pointer, and show the end state under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use shadows, blur or glass on any surface or text, or gradients on any surface at rest.
Don't raise the pointer light above 0.05 alpha on HSG green or 0.07 on dark green, or show it on the closed grey tile.
Don't round corners or use pill buttons.
Don't use rule grey for text or for borders that must be seen.
Don't put text on beige other than ink, or red on anything but white.
Don't apply the IWI cut to white or grey surfaces; it belongs to green fields.
Don't add a small label or eyebrow above a heading; the heading and the grey section fact carry the context.
Don't add looping or autoplaying motion, a seconds counter, or an effect that hides content until script runs.
